analyst.summary: OFSS is a high-quality, debt-free, 30%+ ROE core-banking-software franchise (Flexcube), 72.41% Oracle-owned, that just delivered a strong Q4 FY26 (revenue +20% YoY, PAT +31% YoY, margin 51%) partly flattered by a sequential tax-rate drop and cost control rather than pure demand strength, and FY26 overall grew a more modest 12% revenue / 11% profit on a 9%/8% five-year trend. The key one-off check for this cycle: a ~Rs 940 crore (~USD 100mn) perpetual-licence deal with an existing US global-bank client, announced 26-27 March 2026, had its conditions precedent close only around 29-May-2026 -- AFTER Q4 FY26 ended -- meaning this large, non-recurring, single-client licence will land in Q1 FY27 results due from a board meeting scheduled for 22-July-2026 (tomorrow). That quarter's headline growth should not be extrapolated as organic run-rate. Meanwhile the stock has re-rated from ~29x to ~38.3x trailing P/E in roughly three months (price Rs 9,000s to Rs 11,610, market cap ~Rs 1,01,101 crore), outrunning trailing profit growth, on deal-news, defensive-rotation, and pre-print positioning; a full-payout reverse-DCF suggests the multiple already prices in growth at the top end of (or slightly above) the trailing 5-year organic band, with no margin of safety for the demonstrated single-client lumpiness. No balance-sheet or governance flags; Hold, not Sell -- no quant score exists yet so the V1 default (Hold) applies, and nothing here rises to an escalation-worthy Sell case.
